name: Falcon's Beyond Global, Inc.
summary: Falcon's Beyond Global, Inc. operates as an entertainment company in the United States and internationally. It provides creative and advisory services including, destination strategy, master planning, experiential and attraction design, digital media, interactive software, IP development, and creative guardianship for entertainment and hospitality destinations. The company offers master planning, attraction design, experiential entertainment, content production, interactives, and software services, as well as engages in media and audio production, project management, experiential technologies, and attraction hardware development, procurement, and sales.
